statement.p: Let A = {\left\{3,6,11,13,14\right\}} and B = {\left\{3,6,14\right\}}\text{.} How many sets C have the property that C \subseteq A and B \subseteq C\text{.}

hint.p: You should be able to write all of them out. Dont forget A and B\text{,} which are also candidates for C\text{.}

solution.p: There will be exactly 4 such sets: {\left\{3,6,14\right\}}\text{,}{\left\{3,6,13,14\right\}}\text{,} {\left\{3,6,11,14\right\}}\text{,} and {\left\{3,6,11,13,14\right\}}\text{.}
